name: rustc
about: Compiles one Rust crate. A cargo build can run several rustc processes at once.

name: cargo
about: Builds Rust packages and starts compiler processes for their crates.

name: clang
about: Compiles C and C++ source code, often as part of a native dependency build.

name: dotnet
about: Runs .NET builds, tests, and applications.

name: Docker
about: Runs the Linux virtual machine used by Docker Desktop containers.

name: com.docker.backend
about: Coordinates Docker Desktop services and container networking on macOS.

name: node
about: Runs JavaScript tools such as development servers, test runners, and bundlers.

name: bun
about: Runs JavaScript and TypeScript tools, applications, and tests.

name: npm
about: Installs JavaScript packages and runs project scripts.

name: pnpm
about: Installs JavaScript packages and runs project scripts.

name: yarn
about: Installs JavaScript packages and runs project scripts.

name: python3
about: Runs Python programs, tools, and development servers.

name: python
about: Runs Python programs, tools, and development servers.

name: swift
about: Compiles Swift code and runs Swift package tools.

name: swift-frontend
about: Compiles Swift source files as part of a Swift build.

name: xcodebuild
about: Builds, tests, and archives Xcode projects and workspaces.

name: git
about: Reads or updates a Git repository, often for a command-line operation or hook.

name: go
about: Builds, tests, or runs Go programs.

name: java
about: Runs Java programs and development tools.

name: postgres
about: Stores and serves data for PostgreSQL databases.

name: WindowServer
about: Composes application windows and displays them on screen.

name: kernel_task
about: Runs core operating system work. macOS can also raise its reported CPU use to limit heat.

name: launchd
about: Starts and manages system services and user processes.

name: loginwindow
about: Manages the graphical login session and user session lifecycle.

name: mds
about: Coordinates Spotlight metadata indexing and search.

name: mds_stores
about: Indexes file metadata for Spotlight search, especially after file changes.

name: corespotlightd
about: Indexes and searches app content that apps expose to Spotlight.

name: photoanalysisd
about: Analyzes the Photos library for people, objects, and scenes.

name: trustd
about: Checks certificate trust and revocation status for system and app connections.

name: bird
about: Coordinates iCloud Drive file synchronization for the signed-in user.

name: sharingd
about: Supports nearby sharing features such as AirDrop and Handoff.

name: distnoted
about: Distributes system and application notifications between processes.

name: opendirectoryd
about: Provides account and directory lookup services to macOS.

name: powerd
about: Coordinates power management and power state changes.

name: coreaudiod
about: Manages audio devices, streams, and system audio routing.

name: runningboardd
about: Tracks process state and manages process assertions used by macOS.

name: sysmond
about: Collects process and system activity data for macOS tools.

name: Google Chrome Helper (GPU)
about: Handles graphics work for Google Chrome windows and tabs.

name: Code Helper (Renderer)
about: Renders a Visual Studio Code window and its extension interface.

name: Slack Helper
about: Runs a helper process for the Slack desktop app.

name: Spotify
about: Plays and manages music in the Spotify desktop app.

name: codex
about: Runs the OpenAI coding agent in a terminal.
